correctness.rationale: Under k=m-4 Braun's sphere-wedge theorem supplies simple connectivity. A pairwise-intersecting chord family is a star or a three-chord triangle. A nontrivial rotation preserves a singleton chord only at order two, a triangle only at order three, and no star with at least two chords. The order-two antipodal and order-three equally spaced witnesses are stable. For a reflection i↦t-i, at most six choices of i fail t-2i≠0,±1, so there is a fixed chord. Armstrong gives the cyclic quotient by the subgroup of order gcd(d,6); two reflections generate every reflection-containing subgroup, so its quotient is simply connected. The star-union face poset retracts by closing each nonsingleton star to the full star at its common label. The image is the barycentrically subdivided stable-chord graph, with reversed inclusion order. The boundary of a remaining triangle is sent equivariantly and homeomorphically to the six half-edges on its polygon-label triple; attaching these disks gives the stable-label two-skeleton as an equivariant homotopy model. After subdivision, disk and boundary quotients are CW pairs, so passage to each quotient also gives a two-dimensional model. Integral H_2 is free, higher homology vanishes, and rational chains after subdivision are coinvariants, so averaging the covering H_2 character gives the rank. The signed traces can also be counted on the small model: for instance an even reflection at m=2h has chain traces 2, 2-h, -2(h-2), giving H_2 trace 3-h. Independent replay python3 -B /workspace/checks/kneser.py verified all character cases over m=8..20 on that small model; contracted orbit spanning trees and performed relator substitutions tracking every remaining generator. The smaller cyclic CW models (6,17,12) and (8,26,20) in degrees 0,1,2 give final relations u^4 and (trivial,u^-3), respectively. The dihedral models give a point and a point with one trivially attached two-cell. These independently prove the stated four types. The original flag method is also sound: deleting different ranks in a flag gives distinct rank signatures, so incidence-one free faces lie in one coface only; single-occurrence relator elimination preserves the CW homotopy type by removing a generator with its solving 2-cell, not merely preserving the group. Duplicate degree-three relations attach a sphere after the first relation.
residual_risks: The full attaching-map classification is only for the full cyclic and full dihedral actions at m=8,9, not for arbitrary m or arbitrary actions.

value.rationale: A natural invariant of Schrijver graph symmetries is computed for every acting subgroup, including integral torsion invisible to the prior rational trace calculation. Rotation quotients can have arbitrarily large prime-order fundamental groups even though the source and reflection quotients are simply connected. The exact models at the first two stable widths exhibit this via actual degree-four and degree-three attaching maps and distinguish the reflected quotients.
